summary: DateFormatter is a utility class providing date and day formatting functionalities for user interface and system behavior. It formats dates for display in various formats (ISO, CSV, short, sortable, month-day, month) and parses date strings into DateTime objects. It also formats day selections into abbreviated strings, handles special cases, constructs reset date arrays for academic terms (Winter, Spring/Summer, Fall, Past Term, Today, Custom), and provides logic for managing search date ranges and term options.
purpose: To standardize date and day formatting throughout the application, generate arrays for date resets based on academic terms and custom ranges, and handle date parsing, formatting, and validation for UI and database operations.
entities: TermTypes (enum or constants for academic terms)
Resources (global resource strings for day and date formats)
SessionConstants (constants for default month spans/time ranges)
actors: User (selects date ranges/terms; interacts with UI formatted by DateFormatter)

workflows.name: Format Days
steps: Check for 'variousDays' flag; return special abbreviation if set.
Handle sequences of selected days with predefined special cases (e.g., Mon-Fri, Tue-Sat).
Otherwise, build abbreviation string by appending selected day abbreviations.
Adjust ordering for specific cases (e.g., Sunday at front if included, Sat+Sun+Mon at front).
Return result string.

workflows.name: Format Days Long
steps: Call FormatDays to build short abbreviation.
If the result is 'Various', convert to full string.
Iterate over abbreviation to convert each to 3-letter day format.
Insert slashes or dashes as separators.
Return formatted string.

workflows.name: Build Date Reset Array (search date ranges)
steps: Initialize Today range, Winter range, Spring/Summer range, Fall range, Past Term range based on current date.
For each term type, determine start/end dates using FormatDate/ParseDate.
Select range if matches searchDateFrom/searchDateTo.
Select Custom range if none of the above match.
Set resetDateIndex accordingly.

workflows.name: Build Reset Date Array (for UI dropdowns)
steps: Generate formatted date strings for Today, Winter, Spring/Summer, Fall, Past Term, Custom date ranges.
Handle future request ranges (commented-out in code).
Return array of string representations for UI.

workflows.name: Parse Date
steps: If input is empty/null, return NullDate.
Try to parse string as DateTime.
Return parsed DateTime or NullDate if unsuccessful.

workflows.name: Format Date/Time
steps: Call FormatDate with DateTime and desired format string.
Handle null dates.

business_rules: Day selections with certain patterns are abbreviated (e.g., Mon-Fri, Tue-Sat) using dashes.
When building day strings, special ordering occurs: Sunday moved to front if not Saturday, Sat+Sun+Mon at front if included.
Date ranges for terms are defined by set calendar boundaries (Jan-Apr, May-Aug, Sep-Dec, etc.).
Future request ranges are not currently active but logic exists (commented-out).
Custom option selected if no other range matches.
validations: DateString cannot be null or empty for parsing.
Day flags (mon, tue, etc.) are checked for combinations to return special cases.
DateTime.TryParse ensures valid date parsing; returns NullDate on failure.
Dates compared to current date to determine which term/range applies.
calculations: Date range calculation for each term based on current year, using specific start/end dates.
Highest end date tracked for possible future request range.
Month span for 'Today' calculated using SessionConstants.
conditions: Special cases for days: exact sequences matched for abbreviating.
If no matching date range is selected, default to custom range.
If DateString parsing fails, return NullDate.
Future request ranges only applied if searchDateFrom/searchDateTo match calculated range (code commented-out).

Generates day abbreviations and full day names based on user selections.
